resources.string:
First-run helper: seed the official OpenCode Server list. After this, add/list/default servers inside the app (Settings → Server).

On the PC, allow this app origin:

opencode serve --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096 --cors https://appassets.androidplatform.net
Set a server URL in Settings to load OpenCode.
HTTP Basic Auth failed. Check username and password.
